subject: Re: Kickoff: BERTSeq2Seq for the rewrite features
body:
Status + one trade-off for the handoff decision.

Validation: our stack reproduces the released predictions on DiscoFuse and WikiSplit to within decoding noise - exact-match deltas under 0.3 points on both. BERT-initialized encoder with a BERT-initialized decoder remains the best config for the fusion/splitting family, matching the paper.

Internal fine-tune: on the editor team's 45k rewrite pairs, the warm-started model beats their current rule-based system decisively in Quentin's first human eval round - 68% preference vs 17% (15% ties), n=400 comparisons.

The trade-off: latency. The full-size model decodes at ~380ms p50 on serving hardware, and the editor surface budget is 150ms. Options: distill to a smaller decoder (Tereza estimates 2-3 weeks, quality TBD) or ship server-side batching with a typing-pause trigger. We can't do both by 4/20.

Carmen
